Bash(# Extract just RO data as a test
echo "Extracting RO data from CNEFE22..."

# Get RO municipality codes
RO_MUNIS=$(grep ",RO," data/muni_identifiers.csv | cut -d',' -f2 | paste -sd'|' -)

# Get header
zcat data/cnefe22.csv.gz | head -1 > data/cnefe22_by_state/cnefe22_RO.csv

# Extract RO rows (assuming cod_municipio is in column 3)
echo "Filtering rows (this may take a minute)..."
zcat data/cnefe22.csv.gz | awk -F',' -v munis="$RO_MUNIS" 'NR>1 && match($3, "^(" munis ")$")' >> data/cnefe22_by_state/cnefe22_RO.csv

# Compress the file
gzip -f data/cnefe22_by_state/cnefe22_RO.csv

echo "Created: data/cnefe22_by_state/cnefe22_RO.csv.gz"
ls -lh data/cnefe22_by_state/cnefe22_RO.csv.gz)

Bash(# For each unused function, find which file it's in
while read -r func; do
  echo "=== $func ==="
  grep -l "^[[:space:]]*$func[[:space:]]*<-[[:space:]]*function" R/*.R
done < output/function_analysis/unused_functions.txt > output/function_analysis/unused_functions_by_file.txt

cat output/function_analysis/unused_functions_by_file.txt)

Bash(# Create a more detailed analysis by file
echo "Summary by file:" > output/function_analysis/unused_functions_summary.txt
echo "" >> output/function_analysis/unused_functions_summary.txt

for file in R/*.R; do
  unused_count=$(while read -r func; do
    if [ -n "$func" ]; then
      grep -l "^[[:space:]]*${func}[[:space:]]*<-[[:space:]]*function" "$file" 2>/dev/null
    fi
  done < output/function_analysis/unused_functions.txt | wc -l)
  
  if [ "$unused_count" -gt 0 ]; then
    echo "$file: $unused_count unused functions" >> output/function_analysis/unused_functions_summary.txt
  fi
done

cat output/function_analysis/unused_functions_summary.txt)

Bash(# Look for patterns that suggest old/experimental functions
echo "=== Files with _v2, _old, _new, _test patterns ===" > output/function_analysis/experimental_patterns.txt
grep -l "_v2\|_old\|_new\|_test\|_experimental\|_deprecated" R/*.R >> output/function_analysis/experimental_patterns.txt

echo -e "\n=== Functions with these patterns ===" >> output/function_analysis/experimental_patterns.txt
grep -h "[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9._]*_\(v2\|old\|new\|test\|experimental\|deprecated\)[[:space:]]*<-[[:space:]]*function" R/*.R | \
  sed 's/[[:space:]]*<-.*//' | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//' >> output/function_analysis/experimental_patterns.txt

cat output/function_analysis/experimental_patterns.txt)

Bash(# Quick validation that functions were removed
echo "Checking that unused functions are removed..."
for func in "check_and_adjust_resources" "validate_cleaning" "monitor_batch_processing" "analyze_batch_distribution"; do

    echo "ERROR: Function $func still exists!"
  else
    echo "✓ Function $func removed successfully"
  fi
done)
